Canvas Theme

Source: R/theme.R
sv_theme.Rd

Builds a theme for sideview() and sideview_widget(): a light/dark mode plus optional overrides of the canvas design tokens (the --sv-* CSS custom properties in inst/www/sideview.css).

Usage

sv_theme(
  mode = c("auto", "light", "dark"),
  primary = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  font_mono = NULL,
  radius = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

mode

"auto" (default), "light" or "dark". With "auto" the gadget follows the RStudio editor theme when it runs inside RStudio, and otherwise (and in the widget) follows the operating system's prefers-color-scheme setting. The toolbar button or the T key switches theme while the canvas is open.

primary

Accent colour for buttons, selections and splines (any CSS colour that grDevices::col2rgb() understands, e.g. "#0d6efd"). Hover, focus and tint shades are derived from it.

font, font_mono

Font stacks for text and code.

radius

Card corner radius (CSS length, e.g. "4px").

...

Further token overrides by name, e.g. canvas_bg = "#fafafa" sets --sv-canvas-bg. Underscores become hyphens.

Value

An object of class sv_theme.

Examples

sv_theme("dark")
#> Error in sv_theme("dark"): could not find function "sv_theme"
sv_theme(primary = "#0f766e", radius = "4px")
#> Error in sv_theme(primary = "#0f766e", radius = "4px"): could not find function "sv_theme"
if (interactive()) sideview(mtcars, theme = sv_theme("dark", primary = "#f59e0b"))
